abstract.para: Learn about the configuration workflow, operating system preparation requirements and automated setup steps for &sap; workloads.

topic.para: A freshly installed operating system requires specific tuning, security policies and package dependencies to run &sap; workloads optimally and reliably. &productnameshort; automates the preparation through the following workflow:

listitem.para: Install patterns. Install the specific software pattern for your workload (for example, &hana; or &netweaver;).
Verify tuning. Ensure &saptune; is active and applying the correct system parameters.
Verify security. Confirm &selnx; is properly configured for the installation phase.
